description:
src/telemetry/causal.rs parses and analyses the public telemetry trace. It has no production consumer: every causal:: reference outside the module is either in a #[cfg(test)] mod (pull.rs) or in an already-gated module (public_trace.rs), and no binary uses it. Its consumers are lib unit tests and tests/fz2_cli.rs.

Because tests/fz2_cli.rs compiles against fz as an external crate, cfg(test) gating is not available. So there are two honest answers and they are not interchangeable:

A. It is test support. Extract to a dev-dependency crate the way fz-foq.1 moved fixture metadata. Coupling is one enum (handler::EventKind, 6 uses), so the crate depends on fz and cargo permits the cycle through the dev-dependency edge. 1960 lines leave the production lib and no test-only pub surface remains.

B. It is unshipped production. Trace analysis is how this project sees excess work; if a user-facing report (an fz2 subcommand, say) should exist, causal belongs in the lib and the gap is that nothing calls it -- the same question as fz-foq.5's compile_root_jit.

Do not pick A by default just because it makes the lint quiet. Decide what trace analysis is for, then act.

Blocks fz-foq.4: the answer determines whether causal's methods are in scope for the cfg(test) sweep at all.

comments.text:
Investigated: the filed plan does not work, and the real finding is larger.

Why 'move the 3 helpers into tests/fz2_cli.rs' fails:
- functions() is on CanonTables and reads the PRIVATE field self.functions (causal.rs:122). Moving it out would require making that field pub -- a wider surface than the one being removed.
- formula_totals/product_totals are not fz2_cli-only. src/telemetry/public_trace_test.rs calls them at 10+ sites. Moving them into fz2_cli.rs would duplicate them, not relocate them.

The real finding: src/telemetry/causal.rs (1960 lines) has ZERO production consumers.
- pull.rs's three causal:: references are all inside its #[cfg(test)] mod tests (opens at 2559).
- public_trace.rs is itself a #[cfg(test)]-gated module.
- No CLI or binary use.

It cannot simply be gated, because tests/fz2_cli.rs consumes it as an external crate and cannot see cfg(test) -- the same constraint that drove fz-foq.1.

Its only coupling to the lib is `use super::handler::EventKind` (6 occurrences of a plain enum), so a fz-foq.1-style extraction to a dev-dependency crate is feasible; the crate would depend on fz for EventKind, which cargo permits because the fz -> crate edge is a dev-dependency.

Needs a decision before proceeding -- see the rewritten description.

Blocked by fz-0am. Before deciding where causal analysis should live, decide how much of it should exist: ~669 lines of Replay reconstruct a link the scheduler holds at enqueue time. Answering fz-0am changes what is left to house.

title: Decide the home of causal trace analysis (1960 lines, no production consumer)
